shared_elements: stylised flowering plant on a stalk
multi-petalled flower / rosette-like blossom seen frontally
repeated vegetal motif in a row
field of repeated plant forms filling a panel
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by schematic, low-relief stylised plants: stalks topped by radiating multi-petalled blossoms and fan/palmette forms, repeated across the field, which is a fairly specific shared floral vocabulary. But A organises its plants into strict horizontal registers bounded by a chevron band and a plaited border, with pendant bud shapes and an intruding non-vegetal object, whereas B shows a single continuous column of curving stems with paired flowers and no framing bands or subsidiary motifs.
